name: – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 94637 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow a genetically modified soybean, called MON 94637, to be sold in the EU for food and feed. The Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, especially on long-term effects and on the new insect-killing toxins the plant produces. It also says Member States never backed the plan. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself block or approve the soybean.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw its authorisation plan.
- **Who it affects:** EU shoppers, farmers, food and feed importers, and the company that applied.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to drop the plan or go ahead anyway.
